decision: Retain benchmark profiling; the measured primary index clone is too small a share to justify redesigning publication snapshots.
scope: One primary Index clone in state preparation or standalone publication. Excludes acquiring locks, copying the lazy overlay/witness, and extra background-rebase snapshots.
allocation_metric: Lower bound on live owned payload copied per snapshot, excluding spare capacity, hash-table control data, allocator overhead, and outer stack storage; not measured allocator bytes or RSS.
backend_path_correction: The local Turso fixture uses standalone publish_current_index during payload flush; prepare_state_catalog is used by coordinated state backends. Both were instrumented, so the recorded clone measurements are unchanged.
